title: Senior Channel Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company
Founded in 2007, Olight is a globally renowned enterprise in the portable lighting industry. Guided by the unwavering mission of "Illuminating the World", we are dedicated to crafting innovative, tech-driven and stylish portable lighting solutions. Our core product portfolio covers a wide range of items, including various types of flashlights (outdoor flashlights, EDC flashlights, weapon lights), headlamps, clip-on lights, ambient lights, camping lanterns, work lights, as well as peripheral products such as smart charging docks and optical components.

We are seeking a high-caliber Senior Channel Marketing Manager to lead our localized marketing efforts in the US Tool Truck sector. This role will focus on deepening our existing partnership with Cornwell Quality Tools, securing and onboarding the newly established Matco Tools channel (targeted by Aug 31), and expanding into Mac Tools. The ideal candidate will be the strategic anchor in Ohio, managing alliance relationships and driving sell-out velocity across 145+ current truck networks.

About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Alliance Management: Serve as the primary local point of contact for Cornwell, Matco, and Mac Tools headquarters in Ohio. Maintain high-level relationships with their purchasing managers and regional directors.
Joint Marketing Strategy: Design and execute customized "Flyer Programs," quarterly promotional calendars, and exclusive product bundles tailored for each tool truck alliance.
Budget & ROI Management: Oversee a multi-million RMB ($550K+ USD) marketing budget. Allocate funds efficiently across NHRA sponsorship activation, PTEN media exposure, and Tool Fairs (Cornwell/Matco/Medco annual rallies).
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the local Field Marketing Specialist, setting clear KPIs for truck coverage and regional sales growth.

Qualifications
Minimum 5+ years of channel marketing or sales experience specifically within the US Automotive Aftermarket, Mobile Tool Truck networks (Snap-on, Matco, Mac, Cornwell), or Tier-1 Hand Tool brands (Milwaukee, DeWalt).
Must possess existing, verifiable relationships with key decision-makers or regional managers within Cornwell, Matco, or Mac Tools.
Proven experience managing large-scale trade show booths and sponsorship activations (e.g., NHRA, industry expos).
Strong capability to work independently under a cross-border reporting structure.

Required Skills
Channel marketing expertise.
Strong relationship management skills.
Budget management experience.
Leadership and mentoring abilities.

Preferred Skills
Experience in the US Automotive Aftermarket.
Familiarity with tool truck networks.
Proven track record in trade show management.

title: Senior Channel Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company
Olight is a global leader in flashlights and lighting products, with a strong foundation in Amazon and DTC e-commerce. We are now expanding into the offline Tool Truck Channel and looking for a Senior Channel Marketing Manager to build and manage alliances with major tool truck networks
About the Role
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who understands the tool truck ecosystem and can operate at both strategic and execution levels.

Responsibilities
Build and manage strategic alliances with tool truck networks (Snap-on, Matco, Mac Tools, Cornwell) and other channel partners
Develop and execute channel marketing programs to drive product sales across 145+ truck networks
Plan and manage trade shows, expos, field events, and sponsorship activations (e.g., Tool Fair, NHRA)
Manage a $100K+ USD marketing budget and measure ROI across channel initiatives
Lead and develop a Field Marketing Specialist
Collaborate with HQ (US) and cross-functional teams on product launches, promotions, and channel strategies
Report to the Head of US Tool Truck Channel (HQ, U.S.)
Required Skills
Experience in power tools / hand tools / tool truck / automotive aftermarket
Marketing or Sales-related background with strong channel focus — Channel Marketing, Trade Marketing, Dealer Development, Channel Sales, Distributor Marketing, or Partner Marketing
Experience with distributor / dealer / franchise channels or alliance / partnership management
Experience in trade shows, expos, field events, or sponsorship activations
Experience managing $100K+ USD marketing budgets

Preferred Skills
Experience managing Field Marketing Specialists / Brand Ambassadors
Background or passion for automotive culture / racing (NHRA) / mechanical repair
B2B physical product experience (not SaaS or services)
Experience reporting across time zones / to international headquarters
Product launch or sponsorship management experience

title: Warehouse Assistant
description:

title: Country Sales Manager
description:
About the company
Founded in 2007, Olight is a globally renowned enterprise in the portable lighting industry. Guided by the unwavering mission of "Illuminating the World", we are dedicated to crafting innovative, tech-driven and stylish portable lighting solutions. Our core product portfolio covers a wide range of items, including various types of flashlights (outdoor flashlights, EDC flashlights, weapon lights), headlamps, clip-on lights, ambient lights, camping lanterns, work lights, as well as peripheral products such as smart charging docks and optical components.

About the Role
We are looking for a U.S.-based business leader to take the OLIGHT brand deep into the American market — expanding B2B channels, building trust with local customers, and establishing a localized marketing and service organization that responds quickly to local needs. You will own the end-to-end localization strategy and the operating results for the U.S. region. Starting with marketing localization, you will identify market opportunities, build distribution channels, and grow the local brand. The next stage goes further: moving toward demand-driven product definition, breaking out of the traditional "made in China, shipped to the U.S." export model, and building a complete commercial loop on the U.S. side. You will be fully accountable for the P&L of the U.S. region.

Responsibilities
Land the marketing localization strategy
Research the U.S. B2B market, competitors, and real end-user needs in depth.
Define the local GTM strategy, brand strategy, and channel mix.
Lead OLIGHT's local brand building and market promotion, and build a North American B2B distribution network — with priority focus on government channels, industrial hardware channels, and top-tier distributors — to create a sustainable, self-reinforcing channel growth loop.
Build and run the local sales organization
Build the U.S. sales team from zero to one.
Independently design performance incentives, territory planning, and customer tiering for a local (U.S.-based) sales force.
Build a high-execution local team, enable distributors and frontline sales, and take final responsibility for regional revenue, gross margin, and collections.
Align with HQ and keep iterating
Partner with the Shenzhen headquarters on mid- and long-term strategic goals.
Continuously review channel health, product sell-through, and operating data.
Take on scaled revenue targets and keep refining the local business model in a high-pressure environment.

Required Skills
Near-native English — able to lead senior-level business negotiations independently, manage a local team, and author full English market analysis reports and business documents.
Deep expertise in B2B brand building and market operations — strong command of U.S. business culture, business etiquette, negotiation logic, and channel dynamics; familiar with the North American B2B compliance landscape.
A proven track record of managing RMB 1 billion+ (≈ USD 140M) in annual revenue, with demonstrated success scaling a large-scale B2B distribution business.
Deep knowledge of the North American B2B distribution ecosystem — government channels, industrial hardware channels, and how top-tier distributors operate, backed by hands-on experience developing, negotiating with, and deeply operating key distributor accounts.
Experience building an overseas local sales organization from zero to one — able to independently design compensation and territory management for a local sales force, with a proven record of managing a U.S.-based team on the ground.
Strong resilience under pressure — able to run an integrated growth loop across both channel operations and local marketing, reduce dependence on HQ resources, and independently take the region from 0 to 1 and from 1 to N.

Location
Based permanently in the United States, with periodic strategy alignment meetings with the Shenzhen headquarters.
